name: gate-a-holdout
note: A second pinned corpus, disjoint from gate-a.json. It exists so a candidate weighting derived from gate-a can be judged on cases that did not produce it. Deliberately different in shape as well as membership: more applications, more generated code, more repositories with a single dominant author.

repos.name: aws/smithy-go
repos.note: largely generated code — tests the generated-code exclusion

repos.name: cli/cli
repos.note: large CLI application, professional team, high commit rate

repos.name: dgraph-io/badger
repos.note: storage engine; deep structural code

repos.name: dgrijalva/jwt-go
repos.note: archived; history ends, which tests the rewind against a dead repo

repos.name: etcd-io/bbolt
repos.note: B+tree store, small and dense

repos.name: go-playground/validator
repos.note: reflection-heavy validation, stable API

repos.name: go-redis/redis
repos.note: large surface, steady contributor turnover

repos.name: go-yaml/yaml
repos.note: YAML parsing; long history, small team, heavy test suite

repos.name: gofiber/fiber
repos.note: web framework with an unusually large contributor count

repos.name: golang-jwt/jwt
repos.note: security-sensitive, forked mid-life, many drive-by contributors

repos.name: googleapis/gax-go
repos.note: small support library under a large org

repos.name: goreleaser/goreleaser
repos.note: application with heavy plugin-style structure

repos.name: grpc-ecosystem/grpc-gateway
repos.note: codegen-heavy, plugin architecture

repos.name: hashicorp/consul-template
repos.note: application rather than library — different newcomer behaviour

repos.name: hashicorp/go-multierror
repos.note: tiny and stable — a negative control, case selection should decline it

repos.name: hashicorp/golang-lru
repos.note: small cache library with a long tail of contributors

repos.name: json-iterator/go
repos.note: performance-driven, dense reflection code

repos.name: junegunn/fzf
repos.note: application, single dominant author, long history

repos.name: lib/pq
repos.note: database driver, protocol code, long-lived

repos.name: mattn/go-sqlite3
repos.note: cgo-heavy; a partial type-check is the expected case

repos.name: minio/minio-go
repos.note: object storage client, wide API surface

repos.name: nats-io/nats.go
repos.note: messaging client, protocol-driven

repos.name: olekukonko/tablewriter
repos.note: single-purpose formatting library, mostly one author

repos.name: pelletier/go-toml
repos.note: parser rewritten between major versions, so structure shifts under history

repos.name: prometheus/client_golang
repos.note: instrumentation library with a big organizational contributor base

repos.name: robfig/cron
repos.note: small, old, low churn — second negative control

repos.name: segmentio/kafka-go
repos.note: protocol client with many contributors

repos.name: tidwall/gjson
repos.note: one dominant author, very high churn

repos.name: uber-go/atomic
repos.note: tiny, generated wrappers — third negative control

repos.name: wailsapp/wails
repos.note: desktop framework, mixed Go and frontend
